version.note: Neither source identifies the performing edition. The Peters score used for commentary does not establish which edition was on the players’ desks.

performers.note: The ensemble is named by both sources. The embedded tag ‘Murai/PSO’ is retained as a research lead only; it does not establish a full conductor credit or identify individual players.

date.note: 19 November 2006 is the Archive added/public date, repeated by Commons. It is not a documented performance date. The filename code PSO020103 is not decoded as a date.

place.note: No venue is named. The orchestra’s association with Baltimore does not identify the recording location.

label.note: No original record label or session carrier is identified.

catalogue.note: No commercial catalogue number is supplied.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take or side identifiers are supplied. The original recording medium is not established.

credits.note: Neither a transfer engineer nor a mastering engineer is identified; uploading a file is not a transfer credit.

date.note: The Archive addition and Commons upload dates do not establish a transfer date.

processing.value: The Archive inventory lists 05.PSO020103-Mahler-5-V.mp3 as an original 192 kbps MP3 and its corresponding Ogg Vorbis file as a derivative.
processing.note: Commons supplies an Ogg Vorbis upload with the embedded encoder Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20040629 and an MP3 access derivative. Its Source link mistakenly selects movement IV within the complete-symphony item. The corresponding movement file is identified from the item inventory and embedded movement title; byte identity and earlier editing or restoration are not established.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative from Wikimedia Commons; uploaded file: Ogg Vorbis. Duration rounded from Commons metadata and includes the complete source tail. Automated analysis suggests predominantly non-musical material from about 14:25 onwards, possibly audience sound; the exact musical cutoff and sound identification remain unconfirmed.

composition.value: The underlying composition is out of copyright under the ordinary life-plus-70 rule.
composition.note: Mahler died in 1911. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Commons applies CC0 1.0 Universal to this recording.
recording.note: The upstream Archive item links instead to the older Creative Commons public-domain dedication. Neither reviewed record independently establishes the uploader’s authority over the performance. The Commons licence is reported as its rights statement, not independently cleared ownership.
